verdict.rationale: Stripe documents registrable HTTPS webhook endpoints to which it pushes real-time events so integrations can trigger reactions automatically (docs-38). Terminal payments live in the same Stripe payments system (docs-17, docs-45), with refunds via the API (docs-28) and disputes (docs-40). Missing for 10: the specific authorized/captured/refunded/disputed event types are never enumerated, there is no Terminal-specific webhook documentation, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
